Description
 Devoko 4 Piece Wood Patio Furniture Set for Sunroom, Deck, Backyard and Porch
 Devoko products can meet all your different outdoor needs for all seasons
 This patio furniture set is perfect for family conversation, guests neighbors and friends, or just relaxing at outdoors and enjoying the nature.
 Features:
 Acacia wood material with smooth processed surface
 Soft and washable cushion with high-density foam
 Patio Furniture Set Outdoor Furniture Conversation Set
 All accessories included, easy assembly
 Specifications:
 Table Size: 30.5" (L) x 20" (W) x 15" (H)
 Single Chair Size: 24" (L) x 20" (W) x 32" (H)
 Loveseat Size: 48" (L) x 20" (W) x 32" (H) Material: Wood & Fabric
 Max. Load: 230 lbs Package Includes :
 1 x Patio Table
 2 x Patio Chairs
 6 x Cushions

items.label: Designed for Comfort
items.value: The seat and back of this patio set are designed with a 110°angle, which provides better support and comfort to the body than traditional right angle seat. Come with banding rope, cushions can be fixed in the back and will not move around.

items.label: Soft Cushions
items.value: Patio furniture cushions are filled with highly elastic foam and the cover is made of premium fabric, making it comfortable to sit on. Besides, the cover has a zipper for easy replacement and cleaning, while the banding rope can help to fix the cushion on the seat.

items.label: Free Combination
items.value: This wood outdoor furniture has a simple and natural design that can easily fit into your different scenarios such as deck, patio, sunroom, backyard or poolside. You can also arrange the mix as you like to entertain guests, relax or conversation.

items.label: Please Note
items.value: Patio furniture set are shipped in 2 boxes and may not arrive at the same time, please kindly wait for it.
